description: Generate a Gridfinity baseplate sized to a known drawer preset. Supply measured drawer dimensions when available and the printer build volume; the tool automatically enables build-plate splitting when the baseplate does not fit.

connectMarginCrossings.description: Also place a dovetail wherever a split edge crosses from grid cells into a margin region. Off: dovetails only at cell-to-cell crossings.

drawerPresetId.description: Exact preset id returned by find_gridfinity_drawer_presets.

measuredDimensions.description: Measured drawer interior dimensions in millimeters. These override the approximate preset dimensions.

partsConnector.description: Experimental dovetails interlock split pieces without separate parts and use your printer tolerance for male tabs. They require Split to Build Plates and work with all baseplate types. Clips connect split seams and optional outer edges; the printable clip model is included (not compatible with Skeleton).

printerBuildVolume.description: The printer build volume used to decide whether this drawer-sized baseplate must be split.

splitOffMargins.description: Create outer margins as separate strips while keeping corners attached to top or bottom strips.

splitToBuildplates.description: Override the automatic printer-fit split decision.

tolerance.description: Experimental fit setting saved per printer. For dovetails, 0 mm gives the largest male tab; higher values make it smaller, up to 0.5 mm. Also affects CLICKbase clips and magnet holes. Print the tolerance test package to choose a dovetail fit. Normal bin pockets keep fixed geometry; the included bin-fit sample is a reference check. Values: none = 0 mm, tight = 0.1 mm, standard = 0.2 mm, loose = 0.3 mm, very-loose = 0.4 mm, extra-loose = 0.5 mm.

name: generate_gridfinity_drawer_baseplate
title: Generate Gridfinity Drawer Baseplate
